# Ernst Koslitsch

> Vienna-based sculptor. Yellow Universe — sculptural practice using yellow construction-grade formwork timber, cut by hand, drawing on construction-site material and vernacular carpentry.

## Current

- [Ernst Koslitsch — Archive](https://koslitsch.com/): Current and upcoming exhibitions.
- [Cosmic Trigger – Respawn](https://koslitsch.com/cosmic-trigger-respawn.html): Solo presentation, Bildraum 07, Vienna, 2026.

## Works and exhibitions

- [Works](https://koslitsch.com/works.html): Overview across sculpture, painting and installation.
- [Exhibitions](https://koslitsch.com/exhibitions.html): Full exhibition archive.
- [Studio](https://koslitsch.com/studio.html): Studio views and works in progress.
- [Großer gelber Vogelbaum](https://koslitsch.com/vogelbaum-esterhazy.html): Permanent installation, Hotel Galántha, Eisenstadt, Esterházy Collection, 2024.
- [EX-SITU](https://koslitsch.com/ex-situ.html): Nationalmuseum Sarajevo, curated for rotor, Graz, 2024.
- [It doesn't have to concern you what I believe](https://koslitsch.com/domino-no-concern.html): Domino Exhibition Series, Gallery Raum mit Licht, Vienna, 2021.
- [AU… Ein Platz wird neu verhandelt](https://koslitsch.com/au-platz-neu-verhandelt.html): Public space intervention, Aumannplatz, Vienna, organized by KÖR – Kunst im öffentlichen Raum Wien, presented by Kulturdrogerie, 2022.
- [Yellow Universe — Spark Art Fair Vienna](https://koslitsch.com/spark-art-fair-vienna.html): Solo presentation with Gallery Raum mit Licht, Spark Art Fair, Marx Halle, Vienna, curated by Josephine Wagner, 2021.
- [A Playground Guide to Getting Lost](https://koslitsch.com/playground-guide-neue-galerie-graz.html): Group exhibition, Neue Galerie Graz, curated by Lina Albrikiene, Prize of the Province of Styria, 2021–2022.
- [Come with me if you want to live](https://koslitsch.com/parallel-vienna-semmelweis-klinik.html): Artist statement at Parallel Vienna, Semmelweis Klinik, Vienna, 2021.

## Notes

Static site, no CMS. Exhibition subpages carry structured data (schema.org ExhibitionEvent / VisualArtwork) with venue, date and material details.
